span.div:
Bottleneck Identification Matrix
──────────────┬──────────────┬──────────────┬─────────────
Symptom │ Likely │ Metric to │ Resolution
│ Bottleneck │ Check │
──────────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────
Slow queries │ Memory │ Cache hit │ Add RAM
after cache │ (Buffer pool │ ratio under │
warm-up │ too small) │ 95% │
──────────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────
High request │ CPU │ CPU │ Add cores
queue depth │ (Threads │ utilization │
all routes │ saturated) │ over 80% │
──────────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────
Disk I/O │ Storage │ Disk queue │ Faster
high in iostat│ throughput │ depth > 2x │ storage
│ limit │ disk count │ (SSD/NVMe)
──────────────┼──────────────┼──────────────┼─────────────
Network │ Network │ Bandwidth │ Enhanced
timeouts │ bandwidth │ utilization │ networking
slow │ limit │ over 90% │ or larger
transfers │ │ │ instance
